name: Frame drum daf 6/8
desc: The frame drum in a lilting 6/8 zarb feel: deep center strokes on the two dotted beats, bright rim answers, a rotating rim euclid over six pulses, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, and a jingle roll that fills every fourth bar. Peak is a rolling 12-subdivision daf with iter rotation. A genuinely different meter and swing from the 4/4 sibling.

code.full: stack(s("darbuka ~ darbuka darbuka ~ darbuka").gain(${gain}).shape(.42).lpf(1600).pan(.5), s("framedrum ~ framedrum framedrum ~ framedrum").speed(${tune}).gain(${gain}).shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(1000,2400).slow(24)), s("~ framedrum ~ ~ framedrum ~").speed(1.3).gain(".46 .4").hpf(700).pan(cosine.range(.36,.64).slow(14)), s("[~ framedrum]*6").speed(1.5).gain("[.2 .28 .16]*2").hpf(1100).pan(sine.range(.5,.7).slow(18))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("darbuka darbuka darbuka darbuka darbuka darbuka").gain(${gain}).shape(.45).lpf(1800).pan(.5), s("framedrum framedrum framedrum framedrum framedrum framedrum").speed(${tune}).gain(${gain}).shape(.5).lpf(sine.range(1200,3000).slow(16)), s("~ framedrum framedrum ~ framedrum framedrum").speed(1.3).gain(".28 .46 .34 .28 .42 .32").hpf(700).pan(cosine.range(.32,.68).slow(12)), s("framedrum*12").speed(1.5).gain("[.24 .14 .2]*4").hpf(1100).pan(sine.range(.45,.72).slow(16)), s("framedrum(5,12,<0 3 6 9>)").speed(1.15).gain(${gain}*.45).shape(.3)).lastOf(2, x=>x.fast(2)).iter(6).room(${room}).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
